Atlas.dc.html.oneLineVerdict: An 11-view static marketing brochure for Atlas Golf with NO data layer at all: all 106 unique {{ }} bindings are navigation handlers, hex colors, CSS transforms, or local demo-widget state — not one renders a value belonging to a user, a coach, or a round. There are ZERO ALL-CAPS data constants in this file (verified across the whole script block, 804–930; DESIGNS.md reports 45 for AtlasPlayer.dc.html); the only three consts are function-locals holding marketing copy — phases (807), profiles (828), zones (844). The file contains exactly one <input> (a 0–2 range slider, 141), no <form>, no file input, only onClick/onChange handlers, and only three href attributes in the entire file (all Google Fonts, 11–13) — so every commercial CTA is an inert div: 'Take the Practice DNA Quiz' (236, and the site's primary closing CTA at 774 which routes to /coaching instead of any quiz), 'Get it on Amazon' (295), 'Read a free sample' (296), 'Coach directory & booking' (496), the four 'Start here' rungs (513–516), and all six price-ladder buttons (594–599). Its only genuine contact with the live schema is literal text: six prices ($99/$199/$299/$399/$399mo/$799mo, 594–599 → public.plans.price_cents) and a set of coach names (644–648, 656–658 → public.coach_profiles), all five coach bios reading 'Full bio coming soon.' FIELD SELECTION RULE: rows below are data a reader SEES; ~60 pure-styling bindings (col*, t*, z*Bg/Border, c*Color/Bg/Border, prof*Color/Bg/Border, f*Display/Sign) are deliberately excluded as CSS, not data.

dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal, ~48 lines. 4 facets × {primary[3], alt[3]} prescribed blocks × {zone, mins, name, why} = 24 hand-written sessions. The entire Today auto-session generator.

dataObjects.name: NAMES (in profileVals)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal. The 5 band names per read category used to render 'You said'.

dataObjects.name: FIELDS (in profileVals)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal. 5 interview questions × {k, label, hint} (sport, years, limits, time, goal).

dataObjects.name: STEPS (in profileVals, handicap history)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal. The 6 lookback periods {m3, m6, y1, y3, y5, y10} and their display labels.

dataObjects.name: STEPS (in intakeVals)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal. Same 6 lookback periods with '… ago' labels for the intake form.

dataObjects.name: CATS (in intakeVals)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal. The 4 self-estimate categories × {k, label, question, 5 options} on the intake form.

dataObjects.name: FIELDS (in intakeVals)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal. The same 5 background questions with longer hints for the intake form.

dataObjects.name: CATS (in buildOnboarding)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal, ~25 lines. The 4 read categories carrying BOTH content (what, video title, lesson, 5 options) AND one player's actual results: answer index, read ('4.2° in-to-out'), note, tone. The read/answer/note/tone half is per-player data hiding inside a content constant.

dataObjects.name: GRID (in buildOnboarding)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal [0,1,4, 0,3,2, 0,0,0] — the 3×3 strike map counts out of ten on the Calibration screen.

dataObjects.name: STRIKE (in buildGapping)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal [1,4,9,2,18,14,1,8,8] — the face-strike 3×3 distribution and the 'N% in the centre box across M strikes' line on Calibration.

dataObjects.name: DEF (in buildSchedule)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal. Default session times {home 07:00, range 17:30, lift 06:30, speed 17:00}.

dataObjects.name: KINDS + BASE (in buildSchedule)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literals. 4 schedulable kinds × {k, label, dur, match regex, days}, plus BASE = [2026, 7, 27] (4560), the hardcoded Monday every recurring calendar event is anchored to.

dataObjects.name: RUNGS (in buildLadder)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal. 4 facets × 4 tolerance rung names (chipping 'Two drivers'…'Two feet', putting '12 feet'…'4 feet', approach '10% of distance'…'3%', driving 'Corridor 5'…'Corridor 2'). Also `cleared` defaults {chipping:2, putting:1, approach:1, driving:1} on the same line.

dataObjects.name: AVG / HCP (in buildLadder)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literals. Rung-clearing averages ('+2 or better'…'−4 or better') and their handicap equivalents ('≈ 20 hcp'…'Tour standard').

dataObjects.name: messages (in renderVals)
dataObjects.holds: IN-METHOD literal. 3 hardcoded thread messages × {who, when, accent, border, bg, body} — the entire Team conversation feed, including named coaches and dated replies.
